description: Annual Load Factors by Sector (%) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents the annual load factor percentages for different electricity demand types in Qatar, including system-wide, industrial, and domestic. The load factor measures the efficiency of electricity usage relative to peak demand. These indicators are useful for energy planning, infrastructure optimization, and identifying demand management opportunities. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are electricity, load, factor, system, industrial. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
